meta_description:
19K likes, 401 comments - wilbursoot on October 2, 2025: "At the stroke of every national midnight our new album “One Simple Trick” will finally be out in the world. Created under an inimitable atmosphere and with a broad lyrical freedom I’ve admittedly shied from in the past, tinged with frantic desperation, despair and despondency. There are no words I could write to summarise how it feels to finally release it other than ‘yippee!’.

I’m singing to you here. I guess I always have been, but now more than ever. I wouldn’t say it if I was unsure.".
